# langstate

## What it does

langstate compresses OpenAI-format chat message arrays while preserving conversational state. It uses a local Ollama model (qwen3:4b) to summarize older conversation turns into a scaffold state summary, keeping the system prompt and recent turns verbatim. Achieves 51-54% compression ratio at zero cost.

## Usage

```python
from langstate.compress import compress

compressed = compress(messages)
# Returns a shorter messages array in the same OpenAI format
# System prompt preserved, recent turns preserved, older turns compressed into a scaffold state summary
```

## Requirements

- Python 3.10+
- Ollama running locally with qwen3:4b pulled
